mapper.select: select #{companyId} as company_id, #{billingMonth} as billing_month, qp.query_type, coalesce(cp.query_name, qp.query_name, qp.query_type) as query_name, rs.result_status, coalesce(s.query_count, 0) as query_count, coalesce(s.total_amount, 0) as total_amount from biz_query_price qp join ( select 'HIT' as result_status union all select 'NO_RESULT' as result_status ) rs left join biz_company_query_price cp on cp.company_id = #{companyId} and cp.query_type = qp.query_type left join ( select l.query_type, l.result_status, count(1) as query_count, coalesce(sum(l.fee_snapshot), 0) as total_amount from biz_query_log l where l.company_id = #{companyId} and l.billing_month = #{billingMonth} and l.status = '0' and l.result_status in ('HIT', 'NO_RESULT') group by l.query_type, l.result_status ) s on s.query_type = qp.query_type and s.result_status = rs.result_status where qp.status = '0' order by qp.query_type asc, rs.result_status asc
mapper.insert: insert into biz_monthly_bill_detail (bill_id, company_id, billing_month, query_type, query_name, result_status, query_count, total_amount) values (#{billId}, #{companyId}, #{billingMonth}, #{queryType}, #{queryName}, #{resultStatus}, #{queryCount}, #{totalAmount})
